items.title: Here's what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Most Americans polled oppose betting on elections: Reuters
items.summary: The prediction market industry enables people to bet on US elections and sporting events.

items.title: Cysic crypto bridge halted after unauthorized mint of 10M CYS
items.summary: Cysic said the incident was limited to bridge message processing and minting and did not affect the mainnet or other operational systems.

items.title: Chinese suspect in $75M international crime network arrested in Bangkok
items.summary: Police alleged the suspect was involved in cryptocurrency and foreign-currency exchanges for criminal groups across more than 133 accounts.

items.title: Tether backs AIsa as strategic investor, completing seed extension round
items.summary: The round brings AIsa's total funding to more than $9 million.

items.title: Solana shows resilience, but some areas need continued observation, Fidelity says
items.summary: Solana has had no reported mainnet outages in two years, but concentrations in stake, hosting and client software should be monitored, according to a report.

items.title: MapQuest Now Shows Drivers Where Flock Cameras Are Watching
items.summary: MapQuest's app now offers an optional map layer that plots known license plate readers from Flock Safety and other vendors, as backlash against the cameras grows.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Shed Nearly $1 Billion in Two Weeks as Uptober Stays Red
items.summary: Bitcoin ETFs lost a net $228.6 million this week, following a $681.1 million drain the week before and pushing October deep into the red.

items.title: Banks Hold a Lever Over Stablecoin Adoption, BIS Economists Say
items.summary: Bank for International Settlements economists say commercial banks can slow stablecoin growth by restricting access to payment rails and deposit accounts.

items.title: Crypto Super PAC Fairshake Pours Millions More Into Defeating Sherrod Brown
items.summary: An FEC filing shows the Fairshake affiliate Defend American Jobs disclosed roughly $7 million more in ads against the Ohio Democrat, pushing its total past $46 million days after the PAC expanded its map to 32 House races.

items.title: Crypto Firms Launch Quantum Alliance as 6 Million Bitcoin Sit Exposed
items.summary: The nine-member group, modeled on the Internet Engineering Task Force, aims to set open standards for testing quantum-resistance claims as forecasts place the first practical attack in the late 2020s.

items.title: Chinese Startup StepFun Launches a Phone Built Around an AI Agent, Not Apps
items.summary: StepFun's STEPX Neo opened for pre-orders in China on Oct. 13 at 3,999 yuan, with an AI agent built into the operating system instead of bolted on as an app.

items.title: Cysic suspends bridge after attacker mints tokens and moves $727,000 to Ethereum
items.summary: The attacker, after minting 10 million CYS, managed to bridge about $727,000 in proceeds to Ethereum through Mayan, deBridge and SWFT's Bridgers.

items.title: CoreWeave, Broadcom, Verizon among nine companies objecting to tokenized trading of their shares on OKXICE
items.summary: Applied Optoelectronics told the WSJ it objected because it was unsure how tokenization would affect its stock price, liquidity and volatility.

items.title: Turkey confirms Hex founder Richard Heart's arrest, says police seized $7.15 million and six cold wallets
items.summary: Police reportedly seized $7.15 million in cash, six cold wallets, seven firearms and 1,400 rounds of ammunition in searches of 15 addresses.

items.title: Strive's bitcoin buying spree earns 27% price target hike from TD Cowen
items.summary: Strive plans fresh funding for bitcoin purchases as TD Cowen sees warrant-related stock pressure easing.

items.title: Coinbase to power stablecoin-backed cards for Marqeta customers
items.summary: The expanded partnership builds on Marqeta's work powering Coinbase's U.S. debit card offering in 2020.

items.title: Circle details USDC revenue split, says $819 million went to partners and costs in H1 2026
items.summary: Circle breaks down its USDC revenue: about $1.4 billion in H1 2026, $819 million to partners and transaction costs, $473 million reinvested.

items.title: Crypto doesn't need your party to win, just its candidates
items.summary: The crypto industry has finally found a way to participate in America's partisan warfare without committing to either of the (only) two available parties: help elect people who agree with it about crypto, then let them argue about everything else. Fairshake's latest House spending plans cover 32 candidates, with 19 Republicans and 13 Democrats on the list.

items.title: Two Aave stablecoin backstops shrank $12.4 million as reward rates rose
items.summary: Aave's GHO and GHO-related stablecoin backstops declined by $12.4 million as reward rates increased.

items.title: JUST Completes 5th JST Buyback & Burn: Over 170M Tokens (~$23.53M) Burned Ahead of Major Deflationary Milestone
items.summary: JUST completed its 5th JST buyback and burn, removing over 170 million tokens worth approximately $23.53 million.

items.title: SEC approves Coinbase earnings bets that stay settled when the numbers change
items.summary: The SEC approved prediction markets on Coinbase earnings that remain settled even if the reported numbers are revised later.

items.title: Claude unpicks an NSA mystery behind Ethereum passkey security
items.summary: Analysis of Ethereum passkey security involving NSA-related cryptographic mysteries.

items.title: Trump waives new Russia tariffs as October 18 oil deadline arrives
items.summary: Trump administration waives additional Russia tariffs as the October 18 oil-related deadline arrives.

items.title: Poetic Justice: Scammer Lost $5M in Bitcoin After Being Targeted by Ledger Thieves
items.summary: Chainalysis has revealed that a victim of last week's Ledger theft was a scammer themself.

items.title: BFFS26 Denver: Joseph Kelly on Bitcoin Custody and Credit; Alan Lane on Banking Lessons
items.summary: CPAs, wealth advisors, and lenders gather in Denver for BFFS26.

items.title: Sazmining Now Sells Jack Dorsey's Proto Immersion Hashboards
items.summary: Block's Proto mining hashboards are now available on Sazmining's mining-as-a-service platform.

items.title: Hot Inflation Data Puts Bitcoin Under Pressure, but Difficult Isn't Bearish: CoinShares
items.summary: Bitcoin is still reacting to weekly data but long-term investors shouldn't be worried, according to the European asset manager.

items.title: Deutsche Bank To Debut Bitcoin Custody Within Weeks: Report
items.summary: The German lender is moving fast with its crypto custody service.

items.title: MSCI To Move Forward With Proposal That Could Exclude Strategy From Index
items.summary: MSCI has adopted new rules that could push Bitcoin treasury Strategy out of its global equity benchmarks.

items.title: The White House's crypto chief departs: State of Crypto
items.summary: The White House's crypto chief is departing, marking a change in the administration's crypto policy leadership.

items.title: Wall Street freaked out Friday. VIX and bitcoin say the fear may fade Monday.
items.summary: Wall Street's fear gauge, the VIX index, spiked on Friday as stocks dropped. History says Friday panics usually fade on Monday. Seasonality and calm bitcoin suggest the same.

items.title: Latvia eyes crypto tax payments in 2027 as parliament overhauls crypto taxation
items.summary: Parliament passed a law taxing crypto withdrawals above deposits rather than individual trades, featuring a one-time declaration mechanism.

items.title: Stablecoin supply stalls, but payments jump 45% as Visa, Mastercard and Stripe connect crypto to cash
items.summary: Analytics firm Allium said stablecoin payments hit $482 billion this year so far, up 45%, as card spending surges and global payment firms add crypto rails.

items.title: Bitcoin's $100,000 year-end hope divides analysts as inflation clouds outlook
items.summary: Bitwise sees a potential return above $100,000, while LO:TECH expects a narrower trading range as interest-rate uncertainty weighs on the market.

items.title: Crypto audits give investors false sense of security as Q3 hacks cost $1.18 billion, Hacken says
items.summary: The security firm found that 77% of third-quarter losses involved compromised suppliers, delayed fixes or systems outside the latest security reviews.
